app.message: Service worker is routed by Traefik but has no healthcheck; traffic starts as soon as the container starts
Port 8080 of service worker is added to its Service for router worker
Service worker is a StatefulSet; replicas are replaced one at a time, stop-first
Kubernetes does not copy the image's files into an empty volume mounted at /zdata (Docker does)
app.hint: Seed the volume from the entrypoint, or mount a subdirectory the image does not ship.
